stories.title: Define Trial Phase Quality Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the data contract for trial phase quality scoring, including fields for raw phase (I-IV), normalized phase value, score, and explanation metadata for transparency.

stories.title: Implement Trial Phase Scoring Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to map clinical trial phases (I, II, III, IV) to a normalized quality score reflecting maturity and validation strength, including handling of missing or non-standard phase values.

stories.title: Expose Trial Phase Quality via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Integrate trial phase quality scoring into the evaluate_care_facade so that clinical trial results include phase-based quality signals in the response payload.

stories.title: Unit Tests for Trial Phase Scoring Logic
stories.description: Create unit tests validating correct score assignment for each trial phase (I-IV), as well as edge cases such as missing, null, or malformed phase values.

stories.title: End-to-End Integration Test for Trial Phase Quality Signal
stories.description: Validate that clinical trial search results flow through the system with correct trial phase extraction, scoring, and exposure via the facade, ensuring consistency with existing clinical trials pipeline.
